spans.s: शौन n. (-नं) Meat kept at a slaughter-house.

सौन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to a slaughter-house., &c.
 n.
(-नं) Butcher's meat.
 E. सना, and अण् aff.
शौनक m. (-कः) The name of an inspired legislator older than MANU.

शौनिक m. (-कः)
 1. A butcher, a poulterer, a vender of the flesh of
beasts or birds.
 2. Chase, hunting.
 E. शूना a slaughter-house, ठञ्
or ठक् aff.

सौनिक m. (-कः) A vendor of the flesh of beasts or birds.
 E. सून a place
of slaughter, ठक् aff.
सौनधर्म्य n. (-र्म्य) A state of deadly hostility.
सौनन्द n. (-न्दं) The club of BALARĀMA.

सौनन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA.
 E. सौनन्द his club, इनि aff.

सौन्दर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Beauty, loveliness.
 E. सुन्दर handsome, ष्यञ् aff.
